subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should eligible GitHub Copilot OpenAI Responses models automatically use Copilot-hosted web search whenever web search is enabled and no managed provider is pinned?
rationale: The implementation mechanics are proven, but code review cannot decide whether changing existing users' request routing, privacy exposure, quota use, latency, and provider behavior is the intended product default.

options.title: Approve automatic native search
options.body: Accept Copilot-hosted search as the default for eligible unpinned Responses models while retaining disabled-search, tool-policy, managed-provider, and model-eligibility opt-outs.

options.title: Require explicit activation
options.body: Preserve current managed routing unless users select Copilot-native search through a maintainer-approved explicit surface.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Keep current behavior and pause or close the PR until provider-hosted search defaults are settled more broadly.

recommendation.title: Approve automatic native search
recommendation.body: Accept Copilot-hosted search as the default for eligible unpinned Responses models while retaining disabled-search, tool-policy, managed-provider, and model-eligibility opt-outs.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest history across the affected provider and shared-stream surfaces and is the best available owner for the default-routing product choice.
